features.text: The patient is 62 years old and male.
The patient has been experiencing shortness of breath, especially when walking up a flight of stairs.
The patient has noticed swelling in both legs, particularly around the ankles, which is not painful or red.
The patient has not experienced chest pain, palpitations, or dizziness during episodes of shortness of breath.
The patient has a history of type I diabetes and congestive heart failure.
The patient is on an insulin pump for diabetes and takes omeprazole for reflux.
The patient has not been prescribed any diuretics or heart failure medications in the past.
The patient has not noticed any changes in urine output, frequency, or color over the past 10 days.
The patient has not been prescribed any medications specifically for congestive heart failure in the past.
The patient has not been diagnosed with renal disease or proteinuria.
The patient has been feeling more fatigued than usual, especially after physical activity.
